Karur Stampede: CM Vijay Visits, Faces Accusations and Offers Compensation

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay visited Karur following a stampede that occurred in 2025. During his visit, he announced government jobs and financial aid for the victims' families. However, the visit also saw political accusations, with some parties criticizing the handling of the tragedy and the distribution of relief, while others defended the Chief Minister's actions.
